title: A Floer Theoretic Approach to Energy Eigenstates on one Dimensional Configuration Spaces
summary: In this article we consider two classical problems in Quantum Mechanics, namely the 'particle on a ring' and the 'particle in a box' from the viewpoint of symplectic topology. Interpreting the solutions of the corresponding time independent Schrödinger equation as orbits in a suitably chosen time dependent Hamiltonian system allows us to investigate them using Floer theory.
